description: This file defines the OAuthRefreshToken entity class for managing OAuth 2.0 refresh tokens within the OrangeHRM system, including properties like refresh token, access token, expiry date, and revoked status, with ORM mappings.

classes.name: OAuthRefreshToken
classes.description: Entity class representing OAuth 2.0 refresh tokens with properties for token data, expiry, and revocation status, mapped to database table 'ohrm_oauth2_refresh_token'.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the refresh token record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the refresh token record.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Returns the associated access token string.

methods.name: setAccessToken
methods.description: Sets the associated access token string.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Returns the expiry date and time as a DateTimeImmutable object in UTC.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Sets the expiry date and time.

methods.name: isRevoked
methods.description: Checks if the token has been revoked.

methods.name: setRevoked
methods.description: Sets the revoked status of the token.
